name: slider
title: Slider
description: A full-width image slide show with crossfading slides, animated captions and indicator dots.
improvements: Autoplay follows WCAG 2.2.2: a visible pause button, pausing on hover and keyboard focus, and paused by default under reduced motion.
Indicators are real buttons with labels and aria-current; arrow keys work on the focused slides.
Hidden slides are inert, so focus and screen readers only reach the visible one; changes are announced politely.
Pure CSS crossfade and caption transitions (no anime.js), disabled under reduced motion.
